## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and any remaining limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover relevant success and failure behavior without real messages.
- [ ] Existing configuration, routing and retained request IDs remain compatible,
      or the migration is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and translations reflect user-visible changes.
- [ ] No credentials, real destinations, private logs or message contents are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under Apache-2.0 and have read
      CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
